transcript: If you're using social media for business, stop making these mistakes. Number one, ignoring comments. If someone takes the time to comment on your post, good or bad, make sure to reply, take the time, and treat them like a human being. Two, stop treating all social platforms the same. Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok all have different languages, different content that works on them. Don't post TikTok trends on LinkedIn. Don't post Facebook articles on Instagram. Treat them all separately. And finally, stop trying to sell all the time. People go to social media. media to be entertained, educated, or inspired, not to be sold something. Don't be that profile that's constantly asking for the sale. Make sure to like and follow for more tips like this.
